corpus.license_note: Derived from PHP-licensed php-src tests; kept outside the repository.

references.command: docker run --rm --network none --read-only --cap-drop ALL --platform linux/386 -v CORPUS:/corpus:ro -v tests/frontend/token_dump.php:/dump.php:ro IMAGE php -n -d memory_limit=1G /dump.php > reference.jsonl

phego.compared: token name, exact text, and start line for every token

fuzz.result: no failure; every input byte covered by exactly one token

limits: short_open_tag was on in the references; the off setting is covered only by unit tests.
Only PHP 8.5.12 is implemented; historical releases need their own profiles.
The corpus is php-src's own Zend and tokenizer tests, not real applications.
Error messages are not compared; only acceptance and error lines are.
Tree shapes are checked by unit tests only.

parser.reference_command: docker run --rm --network none --read-only --cap-drop ALL --platform linux/386 -v CORPUS:/corpus:ro -v tests/frontend/parse_dump.php:/dump.php:ro IMAGE php -n -d memory_limit=1G /dump.php > parse-reference.jsonl

result.compared: accept or reject, and the reported line for rejections

mutation.generator: tests/frontend/mutate.php (mt_srand 20261031, three mutants per corpus file)
mutation.command: docker run ... -v CORPUS:/corpus:ro -v OUT:/out -v tests/frontend/mutate.php:/m.php:ro IMAGE php -n /m.php; then parse_dump.php over OUT

grids.covers: expression forms x postfix suffixes, assignment targets, name positions x keywords
type positions x type forms, modifier pairs x member kinds, prefix operators x operands, break/continue and declare arguments
